```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  ai-moderator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'issues' && github.event.action == 'opened' ||
      github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.action == 'created'
    steps:
      - name: Run AI Moderator
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
```
